about.intro: Fully client-side: no uploads, no tracking. Text, palettes and shaders render into one image in your browser, ready to export as a chat avatar, profile mark or team badge.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license
about.resetDone: Defaults restored. Undo takes you back.
app.description: A browser-only gradient avatar generator. Pick colors and texture, export an image ready for group chats, profiles and team badges.
app.name: Gradient Avatar
app.slogan: Type a few characters, get a soft-light gradient avatar
